r4i-fit_session_full-guard.title: fit_session_full guard shape + explicit-None (REWORK 1)
r4i-fit_session_full-guard.imperative: Confirm fit_session_full empty-speed guard returns None (correct Optional shape), explicitly (not via broad except), and new test asserts None-not-raise.
r4i-fit_session_full-guard.finding: CONFIRMED CORRECT. (1) Shape: fit_session_full signature is Optional[SessionFitFull] (line 361), docstring states 'None when no valid flying laps exist' (line 386). It has NO fit_status field, so returning None (not _err('no_speed_stream')) is the correct shape. The new guard (line 400-402) mirrors the existing `if valid.empty: return None` (408) and `if not proc: return None` (460) patterns. (2) Explicit not broad: the guard returns None EARLY at line 400, BEFORE any computation, distinct from the broad `except Exception: return None` at line 487-489 (which logs WARNING). The early guard uses logger.debug — correctly treating empty speed as expected clean-null, not an error. (3) New test test_fit_session_full_empty_speed_stream_returns_none mocks calibrate_session_hp and asserts mock_cal.assert_not_called() — PROVING the early guard short-circuits before calibration rather than falling through the broad except. Test passes. (4) Live repro on real Saudi DEV session: fit_session_full returns None (previously a latent crash).
